name: Radiance Vitamin C Serum
description: Revitalizing brightening facial serum with 20% Pure Vitamin C & Hyaluronic Acid for luminous skin.
fullDescription: A high-potency Vitamin C serum formulated with pure L-Ascorbic Acid, Ferulic Acid, and Hyaluronic Acid to brighten dull skin, diminish dark spots, and protect against environmental stressors.
Lightweight and fast-absorbing formula penetrates deep into the dermal layers to stimulate collagen production and restore youthful radiance.
Free from parabens, sulfates, synthetic fragrances, and harsh chemicals. Suitable for all skin types including sensitive skin.

name: Rosewater Hydrating Gel Cream
description: Ultra-lightweight gel moisturizer enriched with Damask Rose extract and Aloe Vera for 72h moisture.
fullDescription: Infused with steam-distilled Damask Rose water, this hydrating gel cream cools and soothes irritated skin while locking in long-lasting moisture.
Non-greasy, featherweight texture glides on smoothly and absorbs instantly, leaving a glowing, dew-kissed finish perfect under makeup or as a night treatment.

name: Organic Argan Hair Elixir
description: Nourishing, frizz-control hair oil with cold-pressed Moroccan Argan Oil and Vitamin E.
fullDescription: Transform dull, dry, and frizzy hair into silky smooth tresses with our pure Moroccan Argan Hair Elixir.
Protects hair fibers against heat damage from styling tools, prevents split ends, and adds brilliant glossy shine without weighing hair down.

name: Tea Tree Foaming Cleanser
description: Deep-cleansing facial foam with natural tea tree leaf oil & Salicylic Acid for clear, blemish-free skin.
fullDescription: Gently eliminates excess sebum, dirt, and impurities from deep within pores while soothing active breakouts.
Infused with Australian Tea Tree Oil and Botanical extracts to leave skin feeling refreshed, purified, and balanced.

name: Velvet Matte Lipstick - Nude Blush
description: Richly pigmented, non-drying matte lipstick with a comfortable suede-soft finish.
fullDescription: Delivers intense color payoff in a single swipe with up to 12 hours of transfer-proof wear.
Formulated with hydrating jojoba oil and Vitamin E to keep lips hydrated and soft all day long.

name: Detoxifying French Clay Mask
description: Purifying face mask with French Green Clay, Activated Charcoal, and Kaolin to tighten pores.
fullDescription: Pulls out micro-pollutants and excess oils while minimizing pore appearance for a smooth, refined complexion.
Leaves skin feeling velvety soft, clean, and visibly revived.

name: Shea Butter Deep Nourishing Lotion
description: Intense hydration body moisturizer crafted with raw African Shea Butter and Sweet Almond Oil.
fullDescription: Deeply restores moisture barrier to dry, flakey skin, providing 48-hour continuous nourishment.
Delicately scented with natural vanilla blossom for a luxurious daily pampering ritual.

name: Pure French Lavender Oil
description: 100% pure therapeutic grade lavender essential oil for aromatherapy, massage, and calming skincare.
fullDescription: Distilled from hand-harvested French lavender blossoms. Promotes deep relaxation, restful sleep, and skin soothing.
